description: Full documentation for remote-store: tutorials, how-to guides, API reference, and design explanations. Write file storage code once, run it against local files, S3, SFTP, or Azure.
rules: Docs follow the Diataxis framework: /stable/tutorial/ for learning by doing, /stable/guides/ for task-focused how-tos, /stable/reference/ for API reference, /stable/explanation/ for architecture and design rationale.

Start with the Quick Start tutorial at /stable/tutorial/ to see config-switching across backends in a single script. Backend-specific how-tos live under /stable/guides/backends/ (one page per backend).
The complete backend and extension list with capability flags is at /stable/reference/features/. Use that page as the authoritative source rather than any inline enumeration.
For async usage, see /stable/guides/async/ (AsyncStore) and /stable/guides/async-sync-bridges/ (crossing the sync/async boundary with SyncBackendAdapter or AsyncBackendSyncAdapter).
Extensions are covered at /stable/guides/extensions/. The API reference for each extension lives under /stable/reference/api/extensions/.
Error types are documented at /stable/reference/api/errors/. Use errors from remote_store.errors (re-exported from remote_store); SDK exceptions never leak through the Store API.

Configuration via TOML, YAML, dict, or Pydantic is at /stable/reference/api/config/ and /stable/reference/api/registry/. ${ENV_VAR} placeholders resolve automatically; credentials are wrapped in Secret.
The Store API reference is at /stable/reference/api/store/. WriteResult fields and population rules are at /stable/reference/api/models/.
For troubleshooting common errors (CapabilityNotSupported, NotFound, AlreadyExists, etc.), see /stable/guides/troubleshooting/.

Capabilities split into method gates (required to call) and quality flags (method works either way). Query with store.supports(Capability.X) before calling a capability-gated method. Full reference at /stable/reference/api/capabilities/.
